built_pages_note: Measured 2026-09-05 by paper/measure_pages.py and drift-checked by check_paper.py against the author's 25-page rule (NH-028) on any machine that can render in a Calibri-metric-compatible face. THE FACE IS PART OF THE NUMBER: 21 under Carlito, 23 under DejaVu Sans, same file and renderer, so the gate reports and falls back to the 9,000-word proxy rather than failing on a face whose metrics are not Calibri's. Re-measure after adding a figure: figures cost pages and no words, which the word proxy cannot see.
